class.name: PlanetarySystemsModeler
class.brief_description: Tier 2 studio workspace unifying Geomorphology, Climatology, and Ecology.
class.description: Orchestrates geological terrain, synoptic atmosphere, and biosphere Tier 1 controls under [b]Geomorphology[/b], [b]Climatology[/b], and [b]Ecology[/b] sidebar tabs. Defaults to [constant IdeamToolContext.UPDATE_EXPLICIT_TRIGGER] with a causal pipeline strip (Terrain -> Atmosphere -> Biosphere) and a Step Active Simulation command bar trigger.

method.name: open_planetary_resource
method.description: Opens or focuses the shared [PlanetarySystemsModeler] window and loads [param resource].
